items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I was still in uniform and I ran into Herbie and he had a guy with him that was going to be his manager--Pete something, who became Monty Kay's partner--Pete Cameron.

ctx.x: I was still in uniform and I ran into Herbie and he had a guy with him that was going to be his manager--Pete something, who

became Monty Kay's partner--Pete Cameron. We got together and we decided to create a band for Herbie to front. I spent some time with that, we developed a book and we auditioned for a few hotels; we never quite got going, but we had a pretty good little band after a while.
Why did it not get going? Was it lack of money?
